name: Orthogonal Hyperplane Subspace Obfuscation
description: The problem is reframed from boolean logic and equivalence relations to continuous linear algebra. Graph edges are presented as hyperplanes orthogonal to difference vectors, and the tree guarantee is presented as a minimal basis reducing the allowable state space to a 1D subspace. This forces models to geometrically deduce that the constraints form a tree of equality relations, defeating pattern-matching on graph or boolean logic terminology.
